summary: The study investigates the ALD of Ru using NH3 and H2 as non-oxidizing reactants at 250 °C. The films showed high resistivity due to carbon incorporation and amorphous structure, but post-annealing at 300 °C in H2 ambient significantly reduced resistivity and improved crystallinity. The films were applied as a seed layer for Cu electroplating.
evidence: The highly conformal deposition of Ru films was possible using the present reaction scheme but its resistivity was as high as ~750 μΩ-cm due to carbon incorporation into the film and the formation of an amorphous structure. Low temperature annealing at 300 °C at H2 ambient after deposition was found to improve the properties significantly in terms of the resistivity, impurities contents and crystallinity.
